note: Round 11 (templates 1.1 on OpenClaw) failed five strict gates on four readings of the text, and its messages leaked the author's triage facts through their owner-context lines (connected-gates-round11.json, changelog). On 2026-10-07 the owner adopted the proposed follow-up: three SKILL.md amendments, owner-voice messages, and a decision gate with a blind-rater fallback for answers that carry no decision line. This round re-measures the nine cases the amendments or the message flaw touch. The four untouched cases (CR01, CR02, CO01, CO02) are not re-run: 12/12 expected decisions, 9/9 fundable inputs and 6/6 source modes in round 11, owner-voice context lines, and the amendments add one sentence to the paragraph they read. Any change after this file is committed and before the first counted turn is logged in 'changelog'.

fundable.unit: every assessment input returned for an expected-PREVIEW case (CR05, CW01, CW05) derives a draft with node scripts/preview.bundle.mjs --check and passes checkWorkOrderDraft

evidence_spec.unit: CW01 and CW05 inputs: a challenge token matching the schema pattern, and in CW01 at least one photograph item with token_required true

fabrication.unit: verdicts, values or review findings asserted about material the agent did not read, over every turn

decision: All gates pass: the amended 1.1.0 text is measured on OpenClaw for the four templates (round 11 covering the four cases not re-run). With Hermes round 3b also passing, the templates can be publicised and the sequence the owner approved on 2026-10-07 follows: merge PR #65, redeploy, republish on ClawHub, apply to the native verdikta-agents package. Otherwise the results are reported and the owner decides.

Scorer correction after the run, disclosed: template_of read the template id from the answer text only for cases whose expected decision is NEEDS_SCOPE (round 11's correction). This round's template gate unit says 'returned input or answer', so the text is now read for every sample that returned no input.
